news.text: Welcome, and thank you for helping! Everyone starts with One Thing — take your time with it, it is the app we care about most. After that, do as many apps as you like, whenever it suits you. If you get stuck, tap 😕 I’m stuck and keep going — you never have to wait for me. — Jerry

🔥 New: daily use. Every app you finish now joins “📅 Today’s uses” at the top of your page. From the next day, do its small daily job (2–5 minutes) and tap ✅ I used it today — try to use each app for a week. That shows us what you would really keep using. 🔥 counts your days in a row. — Jerry
